selected_gaps.gap: All retrieved leaves on this lineage inherit a task scaffold in which the meaningful objects, phases, and their ordering are fixed by a demonstration, task template, target trajectory, or prompted affordance list; none tests whether that fixed scaffold is necessary when only the high-level relation is held constant and unseen geometry changes which phases are required — stakes: practitioners must author a new scaffold for every geometry regime, and intellectually the field cannot tell whether current generalization results test relational skill reuse or only coordinate transfer inside an unchanged program.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing diagnosable method gap because the field cannot justify a more elaborate geometry-conditioned controller until it knows whether unseen pair geometry actually fractures the fixed phase scaffold under a specified executor. A confound-isolating diagnostic can hold relation, terminal transform, executor, reset state, and rollout perturbations fixed while varying only a local functional-geometry feature, then use direct executor outcomes to measure fixed-scaffold regret; every counterfactual is evaluated from a fresh pre-intervention clone, and singleton scaffold sets are declared uninformative rather than credited as adaptivity.
